answer: An identity is earned, not claimed: run one pinned Quartz shift. A cipher ticket assigns each applicant a random slice of 200 proposals, sealed when issued, so no slice can be precomputed. The applicant runs the registry's pinned Quartz model at temperature zero over the slice and publishes the outputs to the oasis checkpoint ledger. Verifiers re-run five percent and compare byte for byte; a mismatch rejects the identity. Forging 1,000 sockpuppets needs 1,000 shifts of 4 GPU-hours, 4,000 GPU-hours at $1.50 an hour, $6,000, no bulk discount; an honest agent pays about $6 once.
